Maya (growth): Heads up — planning a microvideo launch push + office-hours RSVP routing for next week. Need copy, creative, and routing ownership. Goal: +12% demo conversions from the funnel.
Jon (content): Nice. Thinking short hook + single CTA. Do we push 'try prompt templates' in the post or only in the RSVP follow-up email?
Priya (analytics): Prefer follow-up email for the templates. For routing we should tag by utm_source and ad_variant. I'll own the events.
Sam (ops): Existing router can do this but we need to avoid double-routing. Proposed logic: office-hours first, then demo nudges if they don't book.
Eli (design): Creative brief: 15s vertical, 3 frames — pain, quick on-product clip, CTA. On-screen copy: 'See Redwood speed your model — 60s demo' and a small prompt teaser.
Maya (growth): Who takes the routing config and who owns the GA/events? @Priya for events, @Sam for routing?
Priya (analytics): I can own the events. Will add: `track('oh_rsvp', {utm_campaign, ad_variant})` and a dashboard for RSVP → demo conversion.
Sam (ops): I'll update marketing-router. Pseudocode I'm planning:
```
function route(click){
  if (click.utm_campaign === 'microvideo' && click.type === 'rsvp'){
    tagUser('office_hours');
    addToList('office_hours_list');
    setCookie('nudge_stage','post_oh');
  }
}
```
Keep it idempotent — check for existing tags before adding.
